name: playverse
description: PLAYVERSE — Play Together. Anywhere. Browser-based multiplayer party game for 2-8 players.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,yellow "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @playverse/client && npm run build -w @playverse/server
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
